annotations.title: imagepeek: trace a raster to SVG

description: imagepeek: Vectorize a raster image to SVG paths. Returns traces a PNG, JPEG or WebP logo, icon or diagram into filled SVG paths using VTracer (MIT). Approximate; not OCR. 10 MB/40 MP input; trace <=262144 pixels. Alpha becomes white. SVG <=2 MB/2000 paths, script-free. text/plain; save as .svg. output=url keeps the result 24 hours. Failures not charged; images not logged.. Up to 45 s. Price: USD 0.005. No free tier.

color_mode.description: Color paths, or black-and-white line art (luminance threshold 128).
color_mode.title: Color Mode

image_base64.description: The image as standard or url-safe base64 (at most 10 MB decoded; a data:image/...;base64, prefix is fine); or use url.
image_base64.title: Image Base64

max_side.description: Trace at most this many pixels per side; also capped at 262144 pixels. Never upscales.
max_side.title: Max Side

output.description: base64 (default): inline. url: stored for 24 hours; link, metadata.
output.title: Output

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image (at most 10 MB; private, internal and IP-literal hosts are refused); or use image_base64.
url.title: Url

name: vectorize_image

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
